personality_one_liner: A deeply immersive, cinematic streaming experience that foregrounds content over chrome with rich darks and striking blue/purple accents.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for cinematic feel. Avoid cramped layouts. Padding is used strategically to let images breathe.

do's: Use heavily tinted (opacity > 75%) frosted glass for the bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Apply glass overlay on live mini-player to separate it from the content behind.
Use glass panels for full-screen video player controls and overflow menus.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not use glass for simple lists or grid items.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry via Xtream Codes (primary) or M3U, with Remember Me functionality.

states.error: Error toast overlay with clear 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Hero image background with heavy top-to-bottom dark scrim. Tabbed view at the top of the form container switching between 'Xtream Codes' (Username/Password/Server) and 'M3U URL'. 'Remember Me' toggle above a sticky full-width primary CTA at the bottom thumb zone.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Netflix-style central hub showcasing top content and providing direct entry to core sections.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for hero and horizontal scroll rails.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Full-bleed Hero carousel with vertical gradient scrim at bottom holding Play/Info buttons. Below hero: A fixed glassmorphic row of 5 circular or rounded-rect shortcuts (Live TV, Movies, Series, Catch Up, Favorites). Followed by horizontally scrolling recommendation rails (New & Hot, Trending) with cinematic posters.

screens.name: Live TV
screens.purpose: Channel browsing and active viewing with categorized lists and a persistent mini-player.

states.empty: No channels in this category. Illustration with 'Clear Filters'.
states.error: Failed to load stream. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontally scrolling category pills (Sports, News, Entertainment, Islamic, Kids, 4K). Vertical list of channels showing logo, name, and current program. A floating, draggable live mini-player sits above the bottom tab bar using glassmorphism, expanding to full-screen on tap.

screens.name: Movies / Series Grid (VOD)
screens.purpose: Dense browsing of VOD content with filters.

states.empty: No titles found for selected filter.

screens.layout: Sticky header with sub-category filters and release year dropdown. 2-column or 3-column grid of vertical movie/series posters using 'flexWrap: wrap' and 'space-between'. No orphaned left-aligned items on the last row.

screens.name: VOD Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific movie or series, triggering playback.
screens.layout: Full-bleed poster backdrop with heavy bottom scrim. Large Title, Year, Rating, and primary Play CTA button. Below the fold: plot summary, cast, and if a series, a segmented control or dropdown for Seasons and a vertical list of scrollable Episodes.

screens.name: Full Screen Player
screens.purpose: Immersive video playback with gesture controls and overlays.

states.loading: Center spinner over black video container.
states.error: Playback error overlay with Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Video container fills 100vh using object-fit contain. Overlays auto-hide on inactivity. Top glass header: back chevron and video title. Center: large Play/Pause toggle. Bottom glass panel: tall touch-friendly scrubber/progress bar and time indicators. Double tap screen edges to seek.

screens.name: Settings & Account
screens.purpose: Manage app preferences, parental controls, and view subscription details.
screens.layout: List-based layout grouped into sections. Account section highlighting Subscription Expiry Date in a brandTertiary tinted card. Parental Control section featuring PIN entry and a keyword input list for auto-locking categories (e.g., 'Adult', 'Violence').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6 Glass / Luxe DARK personality: Use a near-black #050505 background with deep #121212 elevated surfaces. Do not use flat greys. Maximize contrast.
Accent palette: Primary active actions must use Neon Blue (#3B82F6), while secondary accents and subtle tints use Deep Purple (#7C3AED). Do not introduce reds, oranges, or standard Material blues.

Text over images: Zero tolerance for text over raw images. Any image header (like the VOD Detail poster or Home Hero) MUST use a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim transitioning from transparent to at least 75% surface/surfaceInverse where the text sits.

Full-Screen Player: Must implement a container-based view sized to 100vh with 'object-fit: contain'. The control overlays (header, center play/pause, bottom scrubber) should sit on translucent glass panels that auto-hide.
Live Mini-Player: Must float above the bottom tab bar using glassmorphism. It should be draggable and tap-to-expand into the full-screen player.
Parental PIN & Keyword Lock: Implement an auto-lock state on the UI side. If a category matches a locked keyword, replace its content view with a PIN pad overlay.
Xtream Codes & M3U Login: Construct a tabbed form. Default to Xtream (3 inputs: User, Pass, URL). Secondary tab is M3U (1 input: URL). Ensure the 'Remember Me' toggle is prominent above the CTA.
Use Ionicons exclusively across the app. Ensure consistent icon weights and filled/outline states per tab interaction guidelines.
